name: S_4 split into an S_3 chain (pdp-split plan 2+1)
mechanism: m=3: replace S_4(x1,x2,x3,xR)=0 by S_3(x1,x2,u)=0 and S_3(u,x3,xR)=0 with one auxiliary abscissa u over all of F_{2^n}; Weil descent to F_2 (x_i in V=span(1,z,..,z^{l-1}), l Boolean unknowns each; u gives n unknowns): 3l+n unknowns, 2n equations; solved by pq_f4_f2::groebner_basis_f4 over F2[v]/(v^2-v); solutions read out by pdp_split::solutions_from_basis and lifted to curve points, checked against exhaustive enumeration
